title: The Kids' Table
text: From Sunday 25 October. Free supervised table-top fun for the littl'uns (3+) while you finish your roast. Free to dining customers. Ask for The Kids' Table when you book.
source: Kids' Table poster on the Hammersmith Belle page

title: The Haunted Hotel: Halloween Party
text: Friday 30 October. Fancy dress encouraged, with prizes for best dressed and best group. Halloween cocktails and shots, and a DJ from 7pm until the witching hour. One night. No escape.
source: Griffin Belle Halloween poster on the current site

title: Last day for the Christmas cocktail deal
text: Book and confirm your work Christmas party by 30 October and everyone gets a Christmas cocktail on arrival.
source: Christmas page on the current site
